label: Phase 3 numbers (September 2026 runs), the 13 October re-runs' scores, and the 15 October kept-land runs' scores, numbers only (the declared chance test was not run on these stands), with, beside them on the same plots, the 13 Oct box runs' stands (the box_runs rows: a descriptive comparison, not a declared score); and R3's four sets, each with its declared chance test (register entry field-r3-scores-the-record-once-they-exist: R3's scores are the record, the _r9 scores the record from before the fixes, which are not in ui_data). The 15 October scores here stay as history.
reading: At neither stand size can the stands be told apart from a randomly placed copy of the same stand map, on drawing or on labelling. None of the ten planned tests passes once corrected for running ten. That does not make the stands wrong: with 267 plots in 20 villages, a real but modest agreement could go undetected.
